Bettina, I can't set this up as a recurring job from here. My scheduler runs in a fresh session with no Slack access. Its output is saved locally and isn't posted to #coastal-team, so I'd be promising a Monday 08:00 post that might never appear.

What I can do:
- Post a "Coastal week ahead" digest by hand whenever you ask in #coastal-team. I'd pull from #coastal-team and #coastal-random and the open customer items, and I'd leave out any money terms, since everyone in this channel would see them.
- If you want it automated every Monday, ask Ruth Calloway or whoever runs the workspace integrations to set up a scheduled post with Slack access.

Should I post a digest now, or leave the Monday setup with you?
